name: Cursor for iOS
desc: Mobile app for launching and watching Cursor cloud agents.
desc_zh: 在手机上发起和查看 Cursor 云端智能体的应用。
solves: Agents only moved while you sat at the desk; you pick a repo, describe the change by voice, and check the run from anywhere.
solves_zh: 过去只有坐在电脑前智能体才动；现在选好仓库、语音描述改动，走到哪都能看进度。
best_for: You are away from the desk and want to hand an agent a task before you forget it.
best_for_zh: 人不在电脑前，想趁还记得赶紧给智能体派个活。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 Public beta on all paid plans; an iPad build followed on 2026-07-29. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/ios-mobile-app
